description: This file defines an abstract factory class 'Psr17Factory' implementing methods to create PSR-17 message-related objects such as response, stream, and server request creator using configurable class names and methods. It handles instantiation and availability checks for these components within the Slim Framework.

classes.name: Psr17Factory
classes.description: An abstract class providing static methods for creating PSR-17 message factory objects with runtime checks for class existence.

methods.name: getResponseFactory
methods.description: Instantiate and return a ResponseFactoryInterface object using the configured class.

methods.name: getStreamFactory
methods.description: Instantiate and return a StreamFactoryInterface object using the configured class.

methods.name: getServerRequestCreator
methods.description: Create and return a ServerRequestCreatorInterface object, throwing if not available.

methods.name: isResponseFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Check if the response factory class exists and is set.

methods.name: isStreamFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Check if the stream factory class exists and is set.

methods.name: isServerRequestCreatorAvailable
methods.description: Check if the server request creator class and method exist and are set.
